Message.Name: System Event Message
Message.Description: The System Event message is used to communicate key market or data feed control events.

Field.Name: Stock Locate
Field.Description: Alway 0

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: The system time when the outbound message was generated

Field.Name: Event Code
Field.Description: Denotes the type of event for which the message is being generated.

Message.Name: Stock Directory
Message.Description: At the start of each trading day, Bruce disseminates stock directory messages for all active symbols in its trading system.

Field.Name: Stock Locate
Field.Description: Locate Code uniquely assigned to the security symbol for the day

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: The system time when the outbound message was generated

Field.Name: Stock
Field.Description: Denotes the security symbol for the issue in the execution system.

Field.Name: Market Category
Field.Description: Indicates Listing market for the issue

Field.Name: Round Lot Size
Field.Description: Indicates the number of shares that represent a round lot for the issue

Field.Name: Authenticity
Field.Description: Flags whether the issue is treated by the Bruce ATS as a live/production symbol or a test symbol

Message.Name: Stock Trading Action
Message.Description: Bruce uses this administrative message to indicate the current trading status of a security to the trading community.

Field.Name: Stock Locate
Field.Description: Locate code identifying the security

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: The system time when the outbound message was generated

Field.Name: Stock
Field.Description: Denotes the security symbol for the issue in the execution system.

Field.Name: Trading State
Field.Description: The current trading state for the issue.

Message.Name: Reg SHO Short Sale Price Test Restricted Indicator
Message.Description: For all exchange-listed issues, Bruce relays the Reg SHO Short Sale Price Test Restricted Indicator message when it receives an update from the primary listing exchange.

Field.Name: Stock Locate
Field.Description: Locate code identifying the security

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: The system time when the outbound message was generated

Field.Name: Stock
Field.Description: Denotes the security symbol for the issue in the execution system.

Field.Name: Reg SHO Action
Field.Description: Denotes the Reg SHO Short Sale Price Test Restriction status for the issue at the time of the message dissemination.

Message.Name: Quotation Message
Message.Description: BBBO will broadcast a real-time update every time that the system's best bid and offer quote is updated during the trading day.

Field.Name: Stock Locate
Field.Description: Locate code identifying the security

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Time stamp

Field.Name: Stock
Field.Description: Denotes the security symbol for the issue in the execution system.

Field.Name: Best Bid Price
Field.Description: The current best bid price for the buy orders posted in the Bruce ATS

Field.Name: Best Bid Size
Field.Description: Aggregated number of shares available for buy orders posted on the Bruce ATS Best Bid Price

Field.Name: Best Offer Price
Field.Description: The current best offer price for the sell orders posted in the Bruce ATS

Field.Name: Best Offer Size
Field.Description: Aggregated number of shares available for sell orders posted on the Bruce ATS Best Offer Price

Value.Name: Start of Transmissions
Value.Description: Denotes that Bruce Last Sale has started its daily transmission schedule

Value.Name: Start of System Hours
Value.Description: Denotes that Bruce is open and ready to start accepting orders.

Value.Name: Start of Market Hours
Value.Description: Denotes that Market Hours orders are available for execution.

Value.Name: End of Market Hours
Value.Description: Denotes that Market Hours orders are no longer available for execution.

Value.Name: End of System Hours
Value.Description: Denotes that Bruce is now closed and will not accept any new orders today.

Value.Name: End of Transmissions
Value.Description: Denotes that Bruce Last Sale has completed its daily transmission schedule.

Value.Name: Halted
Value.Description: Halted / Paused in the Bruce ATS

Value.Name: Reg SHO Restriction in effect
Value.Description: Reg SHO Short Sale Price Test Restriction in effect due to an intra-day price drop in security

Value.Name: Reg SHO Restriction remains in effect
Value.Description: Reg SHO Short Sale Price Test Restriction remains in effect
